paragraph: Gilbert Kirk of Kansas had a silver maple tree crash through his roof during a storm. He told a local news station he did not want a miracle or insurance money. He only needed a tarp. Two days after his televised plea, a stranger stood on Kirk's debris-laden lawn in Wyandotte County. The man said he would put up the tarp. Kirk got the dry covering he had asked for.
